findings.evidence: `frobeniusBialgHom` at line 106 has type `SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐc[R] SymmetricAlgebra R R`, while `frobeniusEnd` at line 133 has type `WithConv (...) →* WithConv (...)`, both under `CommSemiring` assumptions.
findings.fix: Describe the general API as a bialgebra endomorphism and a homomorphism of convolution monoids/additive-monoid points; reserve group/Hopf terminology for the commutative-ring specialization.
findings.issue: The module documentation calls this a homomorphism of group functors and a coordinate Hopf-algebra endomorphism; the same overclaim appears around lines 34, 101, and 129. Under the stated `[CommSemiring R]` and `[CommSemiring A]` assumptions, the declarations are a `BialgHom` and a `MonoidHom`, not a Hopf-algebra map or convolution-group homomorphism.

summary: The Frobenius module repeatedly overstates a semiring-level bialgebra/monoid construction as involving Hopf algebras and groups.
